Meera Pillai
meera.pillai.dev@gmail.com | +91 98xxxxxx16 | github.com/meerapillai | Thiruvananthapuram
SUMMARY
Backend developer specializing in Node.js and Express with strong database design skills. Has not worked with
React, Angular, or Vue on the frontend.
EDUCATION
B.Tech Computer Science, College of Engineering Trivandrum (2023-2027), CGPA: 8.3/10
SKILLS
Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, GraphQL (basic), Git, Postman, basic HTML/CSS
PROJECTS
Multi-tenant SaaS Backend
•
Designed a Node.js/Express REST API with PostgreSQL supporting multiple client organizations
•
Implemented JWT-based authentication and role-based authorization middleware
Notes API with GraphQL
•
Built a GraphQL API on top of Express and MongoDB for a notes-taking service
CERTIFICATIONS
Node.js API Masterclass (Udemy)
